La Fabrique au Bonheur, Event Planning Agency: Privatized Venues and Custom Celebrations Across Paris

Most people planning a birthday, a wedding or a corporate evening in Paris start with the same problem: the venues they actually want to see aren't listed anywhere, and nobody will tell them what's possible until they've already made ten calls. La Fabrique au Bonheur was built around closing that gap, giving clients direct access to a curated set of barges, lofts and private spaces around the city and its outskirts, then handling everything that fills them: catering, DJs, entertainment, photography.

Edgard and the team work as a single point of contact from first conversation to final guest leaving, matching the venue to the occasion rather than pushing whatever's available. The agency has worked with organizations including Engie, SNCF, Chanel, BNP, La Poste, YSL, Butagaz and Decathlon, alongside the private birthdays, weddings and family celebrations that make up the rest of their calendar.

For anyone ready to start shaping an event rather than just imagining it, the next step is a conversation about the venue and the vision behind it.

What They're Known For

  • Exclusive access to privatized barges, lofts and unique Paris venues not generally open to the public
  • Full-service event coordination including catering, DJs, entertainment and photography under one roof
  • Corporate clients on their client list include Engie, SNCF, Chanel, BNP, La Poste, YSL, Butagaz and Decathlon
  • Events planned across categories from birthdays and weddings to corporate gatherings and special occasions
  • ★ 5.0 (75 reviews)

What to Know Before You Reach Out

La Fabrique au Bonheur works venue-first: they start by understanding the occasion, then narrow down their barges, lofts and other spaces to the handful that fit, before layering in catering, DJ, entertainment or photography as needed. They work with both private clients celebrating a personal milestone and companies planning a corporate event, and the process begins with a direct conversation about what the day or evening needs to include.

Get in Touch

If you're picturing an event somewhere in Paris that doesn't look like every other venue in the city, start the conversation with the team at La Fabrique au Bonheur, based at 19 Av. des Ternes.
